title: Why Amit Shah is Worst Home Minister?
description:
Amit Shah is hailed as BJP’s “Chanakya,” but has he really lived up to the title as India’s Home Minister? From the Delhi riots, CAA protests, and the farmers’ movement to the ongoing crisis in Manipur and the recent Pahalgam terror attack—Shah’s record raises serious questions.

Despite being in charge of the country’s internal security, there has been little accountability for repeated lapses. Strong speeches and political strategy may win elections, but can they keep the nation safe?

In this video, we break down why Amit Shah’s performance as Home Minister is not matching the hype.
